prompt_inputs.goal: Prepare for a marathon with a 20km long run scheduled for 10am, requiring high carbohydrate intake and proper meal timing around the training session

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals and includes pre-run carbohydrate loading and post-run recovery nutrition
Pre-run meal is consumed 2-3 hours before 10am training session; post-run meal includes protein and carbohydrates within 30-60 minutes
Daily carbohydrate intake is elevated (6-8g per kg body weight) to support endurance training
All meals respect vegetarian and nut-free dietary restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around long training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and strength with caloric surplus for weightlifting training

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes at least 4 meals/snacks distributed across the day
Total daily protein is at least 160g (1.8g per kg body weight)
Caloric surplus of 300-500 calories above maintenance for muscle building
Meals are timed around training sessions for optimal performance and recovery
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing protein-focused meals with caloric surplus distributed across multiple training blocks

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize performance for afternoon soccer match at 3 PM with proper recovery nutrition

solution_criteria: Meal plan is exactly 1 day with breakfast, lunch, pre-match, and post-match meals
Includes balanced macronutrients appropriate for soccer performance and recovery
Pre-match meal is timed appropriately before 3 PM match, post-match meal supports recovery
All meals respect the no dairy restriction
